label: VERIFIED
extraction: Verification Loop integration with hooks and continuous mode details. Complements PostToolUse hooks but provides deeper verification. Hooks catch issues immediately; this skill provides comprehensive review. Continuous mode: run every 15 minutes or after major changes - mental checkpoint after completing each function, component, before moving to next task. Run: /verify. Phase commands: Build (npm run build / pnpm build - STOP if fails), Type Check (npx tsc --noEmit / pyright - fix critical), Lint (npm run lint / ruff check), Test (npm run test -- --coverage - 80% minimum), Security (grep for secrets, api_keys, console.log), Diff Review (git diff --stat, review each changed file). Output: VERIFICATION REPORT with PASS/FAIL per phase, overall READY/NOT READY.
